question: Change the PipeE() method on RNode in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml from accepting variadic Filter arguments to accepting a single Pipeline struct. PipeE is the primary method for chaining YAML transformation filters on an RNode. Changing PipeE(functions ...Filter) error to PipeE(pipeline Pipeline) error breaks all callers that pass individual Filter values like SetAnnotation() or ClearAnnotation() as variadic arguments.
